gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-serif-hk: Noto Serif HK carries a lightly shaded, dignified texture through every word. Comfortaa draws its heading in unvarying neon-tube line, so the shaded serif below feels like ink after glass.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-serif-kr: Noto Serif KR keeps its s curves wide and barely curled. Page after page, mild thick-thin differences smooth the pace, while Comfortaa bends its cable-like uniform line into friendly headings.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-serif-sc: Neon-tube roundness on top, quiet literary texture below. Comfortaa draws bowls and stems with one stroke, while Noto Serif SC keeps its thick-thin contrast understated, so neither fights the other.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-serif-tc: Steady pen pressure up top, faint modulation underneath it. Comfortaa excels at friendly, ring-round display letters, while Noto Serif TC does best at keeping its refined shapes held open.
gen-comfortaa-gf-petrona: Dignified Petrona keeps its terminal curls shallow and its gaps wide. Comfortaa keeps every join as sturdy as its stems, so the friendly heading and the tempered contrast below sit together without a jolt.
gen-comfortaa-gf-sahitya: Slightly lighter thin strokes make this body text read bookish and traditional beneath Comfortaa headings. Sahitya moves from heavy stems to lighter curves, so pages of text keep an open, uncrowded feel.
gen-comfortaa-gf-sawarabi-mincho: Sawarabi Mincho trims its terminals short of the bowl and eases weight only slightly. While Comfortaa excels at stress-free, friendly curves, this text serif is best at measured thread-like detail.
gen-comfortaa-gf-sedan-sc: Ring-round friendliness up top, a bookish hush below it. Comfortaa holds one thickness in every direction, while Sedan SC lets its thin strokes fall to about half the thick ones.
gen-comfortaa-gf-shippori-mincho: Drawn-wire smoothness from Comfortaa up top, with quiet literary restraint beneath it. Shippori Mincho supplies the pair's finest trait: contrast you notice only on close look, in generously open curves.
gen-dafont-amadeus-gf-cascadia-mono: Loud, wide-stretched letters from Amadeus set the tone at the top. And Cascadia Mono lines up compact pin-like letters with curves matching its stems, so paragraphs move at a steady, tidy pace.
